As per the official statutes, Article 3: Purpose and activities - "The Association has the 
non-profit international purpose to coordinate all the natural andlegal persons and 
associations based throughout the European Union and beyond, which form and 
promote the transnational and pan-European political movement Volt, based on the 
Volt Charter with the goal to ergister as a European political party and will hence act in 
view of reaching:  
- a united Europe that values its citizens and residents, who are able to fulfill their 
unique potential and continuously strive to acheive together the highest standards of 
human, social, environmental, and technical development;  
- a society where individuals have the rights to choose how they want to lead their life;  
- a state that is the guarantor for the rights of every individual;  
- a free and open market economy;  
- a strengthened European identity, complementary to the national and local ones, to 
foster a sense of solidarity, cooperation, and belonging in the European people."
We work towards a uniqued, federal Europe where everyone has equal chances to fulfil 
their unique potential. By uniting our str

engths democratically, we strive to form a 
strong, responsible and transparent European government that acts in the interest of all 
Europeans.  
We believe in reforming Europe to build a true European democracy. We are working 
towards building a stronger European Parliament with the power of proposing new laws 
and electing a European Prime Minister, that will be held accountable in front of all 
European citizens. We think we can shape Europe into a society where the highest 
standards of human, social, environmental, and technical developments are achieved. 
Our goal is to get our own political faction in the European Parliament in 2025. Volt 
competed in the European Parliament elections in 2024 for the second time and we led 
a cross-border election campaign with a European election programme. 
Volt Europa is generating its income primarily through membership fees and donations. 
All donations above EUR 3'000 (per calendar year) are published on our transparency 
website: https://www.volteuropa.org/transparency .

Volt spends the revenues on building the organisations, which prepares and supports 
elections. Most notable, the European Parliament elections. Volt Europa also supports 
the n

ational chapters in their preparations for elections and political participation in 
general. Expenses are spent on personnel, information technology and events mainly. 
If yearly revenues are not exhausted, they are dedicated to the reserves and included 
in the expenses of coming years. Volt Europa holds all reserves in checking accounts. 
https://www.volteuropa.org/policies
Open
Compensation Scheme: As part of professionalism, transparency, and in light of the 
increasing number of paid staff within Volt Europa, a fair compensation scheme was 
developed in June 2023. It includes a comprehensive description of the renumerations 
of the exectuive board members and other leadership roles (General Secretary), 
regulated at between approx. 35-55k per annum. For other key roles such as a Digital 
Communications Lead, Fundraising Experts, and Tech Leads, a renumeration of 
between 30-48k per annum is foreseen. 
Open
General: running Pan-European Communications Campaigns, organising European 
Events (European General Assembly and European Parliament elections kick-off in 
Paris November 2023, European General Assembly in Tirana November 2024), 
formulation of Pan-European policies, engagement of members, growing member base 
and presence across Europe, providing community organising and electoral candidate 
training for 2024 European Parliament elections.
